pages.text: Simulated Coasters lets you lay free-form coaster track with curves, banks and chain lifts, and ride it in carts. Carts are physics objects, the same system airships use, not Create trains.

Place Track Anchorpoints, then link two with Coaster Track to make a smooth curve. A wrench reshapes it, and banking and height can be tuned. Dye tints the rails and an axe removes it. Tracks cannot split or cross over themselves.
pages.title: Track and anchorpoints
Coaster Track
pages.text: Click one anchorpoint, then another. Smoothing is automatic; hold left alt while placing to turn it off.

pages.title: Track Anchorpoint
pages.text: The posts that tracks hang between. Each can take two connections.
Use a Chain to pick a start and an end on connected track to add a chain lift. The shaft at the start takes Create rotation to drive it. Sneak-use a wrench anywhere on the span to remove it.
pages.title: Chain lifts
Coaster Cart
pages.text: Place on track. Use the cart item on a placed cart, then place another to couple them. Shears cut links and a wrench changes length. Build on the carts.

pages.title: Rivet
pages.text: Lets a block sit at any angle or offset. Tap the rotate key for 15 degree steps, hold for free rotation.

pages.title: Red Balloon
pages.text: Lifts a ship slightly off the ground and keeps it upright. Popping one pops its neighbours, dropping the ship.

Create: Coaster Seats adds Lapbar and Restrictor seats in all 16 colours. A Restrictor locks the rider in by Redstone Link frequency or a redstone signal. Coasters Simulated: Track Styles adds a Coaster Style Tool and an Anchor Style Tool for extra looks.
pages.title: Seats and styles
Restrictor Seat
pages.text: Set the lock mode with a wrench: link only, link and redstone, or redstone only.

pages.title: Coaster Style Tool
pages.text: Changes the look of existing coaster track.
